'''Chargrecks''' were heavily armored, spiked quadrupeds native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Orsis]].

[[Trezza]] would take favored students at the [[Orsis Academy]] on a hunting expedition to hunt [[kaabore]]s only to have the student deliberately run into chargrecks with nothing but a wooden [[Spear/Legends|spear]] to defend oneself. Experiencing this firsthand, [[Kilindi Matako]] tipped her friend [[Darth Maul/Legends|Maul]] off, who came prepared with [[electroshock net]]s, stunning the creatures and avoiding this trick.
